name: LookCheck AI
author: rendreamdev

sections.description:
LookCheck AI is a revolutionary WooCommerce plugin that brings AI-powered virtual try-on functionality to your online clothing store. Using cutting-edge artificial intelligence, customers can upload their photos and see how clothing items look on them before making a purchase.

Key Features

  • AI-Powered Virtual Try-On: Advanced AI technology for realistic clothing visualization
  • Easy Integration: Seamlessly integrates with any WooCommerce store
  • User-Friendly Interface: Simple, intuitive modal interface for photo upload
  • Mobile Responsive: Works perfectly on all devices
  • Accessibility Compliant: Built with accessibility standards in mind
  • Secure: Proper data handling and security measures
  • Performance Optimized: Lightweight and fast loading

How It Works

  1. Customer visits a product page
  2. Clicks the “Try with LookCheck AI” button
  3. Uploads their photo in the modal
  4. AI processes the image and shows the virtual try-on result
  5. Customer can see how the clothing looks on them

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Valid LookCheck AI API license key

Installation

  1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/lookcheck directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to LookCheck AI settings in your WordPress admin
  4. Enter your LookCheck AI API license key
  5. The try-on functionality will now appear on your WooCommerce product pages

Frequently Asked Questions

Does this plugin work with all WooCommerce themes?

Yes, LookCheck AI is designed to work with any WooCommerce-compatible theme. The plugin uses standard WooCommerce hooks and follows WordPress coding standards.

Do I need a LookCheck AI API license?

To obtain your LookCheck AI Key, please contact us through our website at https://lookcheck.rendream.com or reach out directly via email at info@rendream.com.

Is my customer data secure?

Yes, LookCheck AI follows WordPress security best practices. Images are processed securely and are not stored permanently on server.

Does this work on mobile devices?

Yes, LookCheck AI is fully responsive and works on all devices including smartphones and tablets.

Support

For support, please visit our support page or contact us at info@rendrem.com.
